Description
: Discover an intriguing assortment of rocks, minerals, and shells housed in a handy compartmentalized plastic case. This set includes vibrant mineral clusters, raw geode pieces, and polished as well as natural shells. Notable is a shell decorated with a Sagittarius motif, adding a unique astrological touch to the collection. The selection showcases various colors, textures, and forms, making it ideal for enthusiasts, educational purposes, or display. The case itself is sturdy and features secure yellow clasps, ensuring safe storage and portability. Each specimen is distinct, providing a firsthand look at nature's variety and beauty. The set appears to be in used, clean condition with all pieces intact as shown in the images. Case measures approximately 13 inches in length. Perfect for beginner collectors, students, or as a gift for anyone interested in geology and natural history. Please review all photographs to see the exact items included and current condition

283547853.description:
Mineral, Crystal, and Fossil Collection Lot
Mixed Gemstones, Carvings, Tumbled Stones, and Authenticated Fossils
Natural Minerals and Fossil Specimens
A diverse mixed lot of natural mineral specimens, carved decorative stones, polished gemstone palm stones, and authentic fossils. This collection features a variety of lapidary styles alongside genuine paleontological specimens, making it suitable for display, study, or lapidary collecting.
Items Included:
Three Late Eocene fossil seed cones (aggregate fruit) from Sahara Desert, Morocco, with FossilEra box and identification card (#277,772)
Polished ammonite fossil half displaying visible internal septa and chambers
Carved black stone cat figurine and small carved stone mushroom
Polished puffy gemstone hearts including rose quartz, tiger's eye, and sodalite
Polished tiger's eye sphere and polished palm stones including malachite, lapis lazuli, and carnelian
Natural raw minerals including pyrite cluster, rough quartz chips, points, and obsidian
Condition:
Natural geological and fossil specimens show inherent natural inclusions, surface texture, and matrix variations. Polished pieces retain smooth reflective surfaces with no major post-production cracks or chips. FossilEra box and specimen card remain intact and legible.

Natural Fossil Slate Rock Pieces with Ammonite and Spiral Shell Patterns
This listing includes two natural slate rock pieces featuring visible fossils embedded in dark gray to brown slate. One piece shows a spiral shell pattern, while the other displays a radial structure, both characteristic of marine invertebrates such as ammonites. The specimens have rough, unpolished surfaces with some chips, reflecting their natural condition. These fossil-bearing rocks are original specimens suitable for collectors and educational purposes.
